title: RLI Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: RLI Corp. (NYSE: RLI) reported second quarter 2026 net earnings of $168.0 million ($1.82 per share), compared to $124.3 million ($1.34 per share) for the second quarter of 2025. Operating earnings (1) for the second quarter of 2026 were $76.9 million ($0.83 per share), compared to $76.2 million ($0.82 per share) for the same period in 2025.
